title: FARCA: Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Factual Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2608.24350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To reduce the hallucination risk caused by outcome-driven rewards in large language models trained through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, existing mitigation approaches introduce process-level factual supervision. However, due to coarse-grained aggregation of factual signals and the lack of reliability assessment for these signals, they create a mismatch between fact verification and policy updates. We term this noisy factual credit assignment and decompose it into two aspects: credit localization ambiguity and credit reliability ambiguity. To address these issues, we propose FARCA (Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment), a policy optimization framework that transforms factual supervision into localized, reliability-weighted token-level training signals. translated_title: FARCA：面向事实监督的强化学习中的事实对齐可靠性感知信用分配
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24350v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：为了减少在通过可验证奖励进行强化学习训练的大型语言模型中，由结果驱动奖励引起的幻觉风险，现有缓解方法引入了过程级事实监督。然而，由于事实信号的粗粒度聚合以及缺乏对这些信号的可靠性评估，它们造成了事实验证与策略更新之间的不匹配。我们将此称为噪声事实信用分配，并将其分解为两个方面：信用定位模糊性和信用可靠性模糊性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FARCA（事实对齐可靠性感知信用分配），一种策略优化框架，将事实监督转化为局部化、可靠性加权的词元级训练信号。FARCA通过将事实验证的粒度与策略更新的粒度对齐，实现了细粒度的信用定位。它进一步引入了反事实...
tldr: FARCA提出了一种将事实监督转化为细粒度、可靠性加权的词元级训练信号的策略优化框架，解决了强化学习中事实验证与策略更新不匹配导致的噪声信用分配问题。
en_tdlr: FARCA proposes a policy optimization framework that transforms factual supervision into fine-grained, reliability-weighted token-level training signals, addressing the noisy credit assignment issue caused by mismatches between fact verification and policy updates in reinforcement learning.
